answer: A sybil-resistant economy can price identity in vouching seats, not stake. Each established account may vouch for one new account per epoch pulse, and only if its own graded work passed that epoch. Weight settles into one crystal per identity; clones vouched inside a kin cluster fold by min-cut into that crystal's single share. An attacker fielding N earning identities must run N independent non-kin vouchers, each writing an original quill of graded work every epoch, since a seat is spent, not shared. Cost: one judged history per head per epoch, and waiting cannot be parallelized.
